title: Lenovo advances AI-powered camera tech from F1 to World #lenovo #worldcuptech #broadcastinnovation
description: Lenovo developed AI-powered camera technology originally used in Formula 1 to stabilize footage, correct color and exposure, and reduce shake in high-speed environments. This technology was adapted for the World Cup to enhance live broadcasts from cameras built into referees' headsets, providing clear and stable footage even during intense motion. The system processes raw video through AI models that analyze and correct every frame within seconds, maintaining sharpness and minimizing visual distortion by up to 60%. This innovation allows viewers to experience first-person referee angles without discomfort, improving the quality and immersion of sports broadcasts. By leveraging advanced AI from motorsport, Lenovo transformed live sports coverage, showcasing how cross-industry tech applications can elevate broadcast standards and viewer engagement in major global events. #Lenovo #WorldCupTech #RefCam #AIStabilization #Formula1Tech #SportsBroadcasting #AIinSports #LiveSportsTech #VideoStabilization #FootballTechnology #RefereeCamera #BroadcastInnovation #TechInSports #WorldCup2022 #LenovoAI
